newsitem.title: USA: Merck Q2 shr $0.96, beats expectations.
newsitem.headline: Merck Q2 shr $0.96, beats expectations.

text.p: Merck & Co said Thursday its earnings per share for the second quarter of 1997 were $0.96, an increase of twenty percent over the same quarter of 1996 and slightly above Wall Street expectations.
Second quarter net income rose 19 percent to $1.15 billion. Sales for the quarter were $5.9 billion, up 20 percent from the year-ago period, the company said.
Foreign exchange reduced second quarter sales growth by one percentage point, the same effect seen in the first quarter of 1997, Merck said.
The First Call consensus analyst estimate was earnings of $0.95 per share for the 1997 second quarter.

"Sales growth for the quarter and the first half of 1997 continued to be led by established major products, recent product introductions and the Merck-Medco Managed Care business," said Raymond Gilmartin, Merck's chief executive officer.
"Both our domestic and international operations reported strong unit volume gains," he said.
Merck said earnings per share for the first half of 1997 were $1.80, up twenty percent from the first half of 1996.
